page_title: ATM 3-2 CAD | Atletico Madrid v Cadiz CF 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Javier Iglesias Villanueva has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
90+3' Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+2' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) for a tough tackle.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

88' A neat pass is well received by Iza Carcelen (Cadiz), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
88' It will be a corner kick for Cadiz CF.
88' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

87' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Conan Ledesma made an astonishing save!
85' The Cadiz CF players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
81' That will be all from Cesar Azpilicueta who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
80' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle and it's Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

80' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Conan Ledesma guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
78' That was close by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
75' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
74' The current number of shots on goal is 7:3.
70' Sergio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) replacing Jorge Mere.
66' 3 - 2 Goal! Saul Niguez puts the ball across the area and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 3:2.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is replacing Joseba Zaldua.
61' Substitution. Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Rodrigo Riquelme.
61' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Koke and he is replaced by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).
61' A substitution has been made. Marcos Llorente goes off and Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
60' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
58' The linesman makes the right call and Cadiz CF will have a corner.

57' What a save from Jan Oblak! Chris Ramos (Cadiz) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
56' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
56' An attempted cross from Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
54' A pass from Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Conan Ledesma and the move breaks down.
54' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
52' The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.

51' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Conan Ledesma thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
46' 2 - 2 Goal! Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 2:2.
46' A fine pass finds Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Conan Ledesma reacts superbly to deny him.
46' Sergio makes a half-time substitution. Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) comes on in place of Ruben Alcaraz.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Roger Marti is replaced by Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz).
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
45+4' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' The ratio of the ball possession is 73:27.
41' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Conan Ledesma comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' A long ball forward to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted.
39' Roger Marti (Cadiz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
37' The ball goes out of play. Cadiz CF are awarded a corner kick.
37' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
35' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Fali leaves the pitch to be replaced by Mamadou Mbaye (Cadiz).
33' Fali (Cadiz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' 1 - 2 Goal! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Cesar Azpilicueta and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 1:2.
31' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Conan Ledesma makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
27' 0 - 2 Goal! Roger Marti (Cadiz) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 0:2.
27' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
26' Atl. Madrid are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
26' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) is penalised for holding. Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals a set piece.
24' Conan Ledesma displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
22' What a great effort! Fali (Cadiz) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
22' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
18' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
12' Koke (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
12' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Chris Ramos sprays a pass out to Lucas Pires (Cadiz), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
12' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross inside the box, but Conan Ledesma wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
9' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
9' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Saul Niguez.

5' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Conan Ledesma thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Cadiz CF will kick the game off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva was nominated as the referee for this game.
